programme.desc: Toque 12 host chef Phillip previews the Toque 12 Master Chef Epicurian Market Event. He introduces the celebrity chefs and outlines the fun to follow in the six-episode series.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Phillip takes on the Epicurean Market Challenge. Try and taste everything and then talk to the chefs about what he is eating. This episode features chefs that are famous now and some who will be in the future.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Phillip gives us a first hand rundown on what's on offer in the Epicurean Market and why this event, now in its third year, doubles its attendance every year.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This is the last day of the market event and everyone is in party mode. However, the business of eating is Chef Phillip's main task and he doesn't fail on any level.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Phillip takes into the realms of the megastar chefs. We get close-ups of Tetsuya, Quek and some more of Silverton, Wolfgang Pukc, Gordon and Batali. This episode is crammed full of advice, tips and recipes.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: What makes the Epicurean Market actually work? We find out. Then there's more tips, more fun with the Mystery Box Challenge, highlights of the weekend including a curry master class from David Thompson. It' a full celebration of an epic Epicurean event.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Host Chef Phillip Davenport asks why so very few people outside of Malaysia ever discuss, let alone praise its fine dining venues so we begin by providing the evidence that the Capital city Kuala Lumpur has the fine dining credentials and an ever growing list of culinary geniuses.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Phil delves into the KL city's suburban and modern mall food culture. His theory is that a measure of a cities culinary excellence is how good the suburban restaurants are.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Amid the leafy enclosure of KL suburbia lies a piece of exotic Ceylon, namely Aliyaa Restaurant and Bar and its where Chef Phil discovers exec Chef Pradeep specialising in his signature dry cooked curries.This is what fine dining Sri Lankan cuisine is all about.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Isadora Chai is a chef who was a scientist so experimentation is what she thrives on and when she opens her mouth this chef can swear like Gordon Ramsay and invariably does. A fun episode

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: A beautiful tropical island, two world class restaurants and two great Chefs ,Chef Phil and his old friend Chef Richard. They take us on a culinary tour de force presenting some intriguing western recipes and a range delicious modern Langkawi/Malaysia fare.This is a recipe intense episode with plenty to see and learn.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Phil arrives at the Imperial Sheraton, home of the Celestial Court and his base while he uncovers the enormous culinary exercise that takes place every day here. We begin the Celestial Court where the decisions on what to cook are tough but we end up with classic crispy skinned Roast Duck, Di Sum and a Wok fried Chilli Tempe thats a world beater.
